resources.string: Stayput detects which app is open to block apps during focus sessions. If you turn on Scroll check-in, Stayput also times how long the apps you choose stay open between sessions and shows a prompt to take a break. Stayput processes this on your device. It does not read screen text, record actions, or send data anywhere.
